name: Aisyah binti Rahman
bio:
Aisyah's journey began in her family's bustling hawker stall in Kuala Lumpur, where she learned the importance of fresh ingredients and efficient service. Her passion for motorsport sparked during a local rally event, where she was captivated by the energy and camaraderie. Seeking a way to combine her culinary skills with her newfound interest, Aisyah pursued opportunities within motorsport catering, gradually building her reputation for delivering high-quality meals under pressure. 

At Hansen World RX Team, Aisyah ensures the entire team is well-fed and energized, from the mechanics to the drivers. She's known for her ability to source local ingredients, creating menus that are both nutritious and culturally relevant. Aisyah's pragmatic approach means she's always prepared for logistical challenges, ensuring that every meal is served on time, regardless of the race location or schedule changes. She is also known for her meticulous organization and her talent for creating a positive and supportive atmosphere within the team's catering area.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Aisyah is a woman of average height with a warm, inviting smile and a practical, no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Insists on starting every day with a cup of teh tarik.
Always has a small container of homemade sambal to spice up any meal.
Memorizes everyone's favorite dish and tries to incorporate it into the menu rotation.
